title: Ideaspace Note frontmatter (Layer 1)
description: The portable, author-owned frontmatter of a knowledge Note — what travels in the file, as opposed to provenance in git or hosted coordination state. PROVISIONAL, v0.13.0. Per the spec, an absent field is a drift signal, not an error — nothing is strictly required. Additional fields are allowed so the leaf stays extensible.

summary.description: What this is about, compressed. Orients a reader without querying anything.

description.description: When this applies — the trigger condition. The convention `_agent/skills/` entries carry (per the open Agent Skills spec, where it is the field an agent matches on); awareness prefers it over `summary` for skills. Ordinary knowledge Notes use `summary`.

attached_to.description: A SINGLE typed link to the entity this Note is about (subject, not provenance), written `<type>:<id>`. One value by design — the inverse fan-in (a thing having many Notes) is the platform's job, not the file's. The type namespace is PLATFORM-DEFINED and open, like the underscore extension point: the protocol fixes only the `<type>:<id>` shape; a platform declares which types it resolves.

tags.description: Flat classifiers within the directory model.

map.description: Optional provisional Map projection. Invalid Map guidance does not make the surrounding Note unreadable or add a base repository-conformance failure.

space.description: Canonical remote locator: lowercase host plus repository path, without scheme, credentials, query, fragment, trailing slash, or .git.

sha.description: Full resolved Git commit object id, never a ref.

x-status: provisional and public — expect breaking changes before 1.0
x-notes: Subject and optional portable Map guidance ride in frontmatter; provenance (author, co-author, Change-Id) rides in git; internal platform storage handles never enter the file.
A declared map block follows schema/maps.md. It is provisional guidance: malformed Map data is drift local to that projection, not a rejected Note or base repository-conformance failure.
Other fields are permitted via additionalProperties but are not standardized here.
The attached_to type namespace is platform-defined: the protocol fixes the `<type>:<id>` shape only. x-platform-type-examples lists illustrative types; each platform declares the ones it resolves.
